blocks.text: Sugar, CO₂ ke reduction se banti hai jis mein ATP aur NADPH istemal hote hain; is tarah CO₂ sugar banane ke liye carbon ka zariya (source) hai. Carbon dioxide stomata (patte ke baareek suraakh) se patte mein dakhil hoti hai aur mesophyll cells ki cell walls mein maujood pani mein ghul jati hai. Patton mein stomata bari tadad mein hote hain, aur CO₂ ka andar aana stomata khulne par munhasir hai.

blocks.title: Photosynthesis kahan hoti hai
blocks.text: Kul photosynthesis ka taqreeban 10% khushki ke poday karte hain; baqi samandaron, jheelon aur talabon mein hota hai. Pani ke photosynthetic jandar ghuli hui CO₂, bicarbonates aur ghulne wale carbonates ko carbon ke zariye ke taur par istemal karte hain; khushki ke jandar hawa ki CO₂ istemal karte hain.

blocks.title: Hypothesis ki bunyad
blocks.text: Van Niel ka mafrooza (hypothesis) un photosynthetic bacteria ki tehqeeq par mabni tha jo carbon dioxide se carbohydrate banate hain magar oxygen nahin chhorte.
